claims.evidence: Photos show only exterior surfaces; no video of treadle action, stitching test, or close-up of mechanical parts to confirm 'perfect' condition.

risks.risk: Treadle mechanism may not move smoothly or belt wheel may be seized/rusted internally.
risks.proof: Short video of the treadle being pumped and the wheel turning, with the belt engaged.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional/manual-only with unknown mechanical condition

risks.risk: Machine head may not produce proper stitches (tension, needle bar, bobbin mechanism).
risks.proof: Video of an actual stitch being sewn on scrap fabric.
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested, assume stitch quality unverified

risks.risk: Wood table/cabinet may have hidden cracks, woodworm, or rot not visible in the given angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of drawer joints, underside of table, and legs in good light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-only condition, assume possible structural wear

risks.risk: Missing accessories (bobbins, needles, extra attachments) that affect usability.
risks.proof: Photo of the accessory drawer contents or included parts laid out.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare machine with no accessories included

risks.risk: Internal rust on gears, shuttle, or tension assembly not visible externally.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the open machine interior/underside.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possible rust/wear, same as worst-case mechanical risk

proof_requests: Video of the treadle being operated and the wheel turning smoothly
Video of an actual stitch being sewn on fabric
Close-up photos of the wood joints, drawer interior, and underside of the table
Photo of included accessories (bobbins, needles, extra parts)
Close-up photo of the machine's internal mechanism (opened panel or underside)
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Mercury treadle sewing machine with cabinet table, so it can be priced, but the seller's 'perfect condition' claim is unverifiable remotely and must be priced at worst case pending proof of mechanical and cosmetic condition.
